summary: Implement slice 1-3 of the local AI worker: durable event journal with cursors, deterministic alert broker, and honest resumable job store

coordination.notes: Continues PR #285 (branch feat/live-isometric-cell-contract), which is OPEN and not merged; docs/LOCAL_AI_BACKGROUND_WORKER.md exists only there, so this builds on that branch rather than main. No active or blocked claims overlap: codex-root's local-ai-background-worker claim is completed and documentation-only, explicitly disclaiming runtime implementation. CANONICAL OWNERS FOUND, none of which are replaced or duplicated: game-line/event owner is src/lib/gameStream.ts (feed -> StreamLine) over src/lib/gameLink.ts's bounded live buffer (MAX_LINES 20000, dropped counter, version, subscribeGame), fed natively by src-tauri/src/game_link.rs emitting game:line/game:state. State owner is src/store/useAppStore.ts. Alert machinery is src/lib/alertGate.ts (alertGate, AlertChannel, PER_SOUND_MS, GLOBAL_MS) with alertSound.ts and alertPlaybackStatus.ts. Persistence is src/lib/storage.ts (readJSON/writeJSON returning StorageWriteResult). Task/runner system is src/lib/pythonTasks.ts and nodeTasks.ts over src-tauri/src/python.rs and node.rs, with stopAllTasks.ts and flowStop.ts. Game-command boundary is gameCommand.ts (validateGameCommand, validateGameActionCommand) -> gameActions.ts (sendGameAction, requestGameAction) -> gameLink.ts (sendGame) -> Tauri game_send. NEW MODULES ARE JUSTIFIED ONLY WHERE NOTHING OWNS THE RESPONSIBILITY: no cursor, acknowledgement, durable job status, or preemption mechanism exists anywhere in the repository - gameLink's buffer is a live display ring that silently drops the oldest lines when full, which is correct for a text pane and unusable as a delivery guarantee. These modules do not parse game text, do not own live state, do not call a model, and cannot reach the command boundary; dependencies point one way only (journal and broker depend on nothing, job store depends on storage.ts, scheduler depends on the three types). No model provider is integrated in this slice.
